They have ratified the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) 1.0 specification, an open industry standard for package-level connectivity. This initiative aims to reduce development time and cost, promoting customizable and interoperable chiplet designs for future silicon innovations.

feed.title: Our Ultimate Stock-Pickers' Top 10 Buys and Sells
feed.summary: This article identifies the top 10 high-conviction buys and sells among Morningstar's Ultimate Stock-Pickers for the fourth quarter of 2021, based on an aggregate analysis of their holdings. It highlights key companies like Microsoft and 3M as top buys and Marsh & McLennan as a prominent sell, detailing the Morningstar analysts' fair value estimates, economic moats, and investment theses for these firms. The report assists investors by providing insights into attractive investment ideas and valuation considerations.

feed.title: Adaptive Biotechnologies lays off 12% of workforce to narrow immunosequencing tech
feed.summary: Adaptive Biotechnologies announced a layoff of 12% of its workforce (about 100 employees) as part of a restructuring to focus on two core areas: minimal residual disease and immune medicine. The company also appointed Tycho Peterson as the new CFO, a move analysts believe will positively impact its stock. These changes aim to streamline operations and clarify the company's mission for investors.

feed.title: Billion-dollar Seattle company Adaptive Biotechnologies lays off 100
feed.summary: Seattle-based Adaptive Biotechnologies, valued at $1.6 billion, announced a layoff of 100 employees from its 850-worker staff as part of a restructuring effort. The company is streamlining its workforce and appointing a new chief financial officer while focusing on its cancer diagnostic test, clonoSEQ, and infectious disease-specific cell mapping research. Despite a pandemic-driven stock price surge, shares have significantly declined from their January 2021 high.

feed.title: Lumen (like the field) is pulling out of Russia. What's next?
feed.summary: Lumen, an internet backbone company known for its naming rights to a Seattle sports stadium, is pulling its services out of Russia. This decision, following similar moves by other companies like Cogen, could significantly impact Russia's internet access, potentially leading to slower connectivity and isolation from the global web. An editor from DatacenterDynamics explains that Lumen's role as a major international transit provider means its withdrawal is a substantial move towards disconnecting Russia.

feed.title: Adobe Acrobat Sign and Adobe Experience Cloud modernize customer and employee experiences
feed.summary: Adobe is enhancing the integration between Adobe Acrobat Sign and Adobe Experience Cloud to streamline digital document signing workflows for businesses. These advancements aim to improve efficiency, save time, and reduce costs. The new functionalities include faster e-signatures for work management, digitized commerce transactions, and personalized onboarding experiences.

feed.title: Leaks of Conti Ransomware Group Paint Picture of a Surprisingly Normal Tech Start-Up... Sort Of
feed.summary: A leak of hundreds of thousands of internal communications from the Conti ransomware group reveals a surprisingly corporate-like structure, complete with HR, hiring processes, salaries, and even performance reviews. The analysis details their organizational hierarchy, diverse teams (coders, testers, OSINT specialists), and recruitment methods, which include legitimate job sites. Despite the massive breach and internal turmoil, the article concludes that Conti is "Too Big To Fail" and will likely re-emerge.

feed.title: Disney ‘Taking Steps to Pause’ All Business in Russia
feed.summary: The Walt Disney Company announced it is "taking steps to pause" all other businesses in Russia, beyond its initial halt on new movie releases, due to the "unprovoked invasion of Ukraine" and escalating humanitarian crisis. This includes content and product licensing, Disney Cruise Line activities, National Geographic magazine and tours, local content productions, and linear channels. Disney stated that while some activities can be paused immediately, others will take time due to contractual complexities, and staff in Russia will remain employed.

feed.title: Here’s How ICE Illegally Obtained Bulk Financial Records from Western Union
feed.summary: Senator Ron Wyden has revealed that Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), a unit within ICE, illegally obtained millions of financial records from Western Union and Maxitransfers Corporation using administrative subpoenas. These subpoenas compelled the companies to provide records of money transfers over $500 to or from certain U.S. states and Mexico, which were then stored in a database accessible to hundreds of law enforcement agencies. This bulk surveillance is deemed illegal due to the misuse of administrative subpoenas, which are statutorily required to seek records "relevant" to specific investigations.

feed.title: Biden must safeguard Russian internet access, civil society warns
feed.summary: Civil society groups are urging the Biden administration to protect internet providers in Russia from sanctions, arguing that cutting off web access would isolate dissidents and strengthen the Kremlin's control. They recommend that the Office of Foreign Asset Controls formally authorize U.S. internet services, software, and hardware to preserve web access, citing precedents from past sanctions campaigns. The groups warn that without clear guidance, individuals in Russia could be cut off from vital internet services.

feed.title: Grizzle Growth ETF (GRZZ) Stock Price, News, Quote & History
feed.summary: This article provides detailed information on the Grizzle Growth ETF (GRZZ), including its current stock price, historical data, and performance metrics. It outlines the ETF's investment strategy, top holdings like NVIDIA and Microsoft, and sector weightings. The page also features related ETF news and research reports from analysts regarding other companies.

feed.title: FIFA Ultimate Team cards aren’t gambling, Dutch court says
feed.summary: A Dutch appeals court has overturned a 2020 ruling that declared EA Sports' FIFA Ultimate Team card packs a form of gambling, rescinding a €10 million fine against Electronic Arts. The court determined that opening card packs is part of a game of skill and not an isolated game of chance. Electronic Arts celebrated the decision, reiterating its commitment to player choice, fun, fairness, and value in game design.

feed.title: Is India ready to embrace Industry 4.0?
feed.summary: This article explores India's readiness for Industry 4.0, featuring an interview with Amit Saluja, Senior Director Head of NASSCOM center at Gandhinagar. Saluja discusses how Industry 4.0 differs from previous industrial revolutions by focusing on organizational transformation beyond just manufacturing, driven by AI, IoT, and analytics. He acknowledges India's slow start but highlights increased awareness and proactive adoption, especially among mid-sized companies, emphasizing that Industry 4.0 is crucial for future readiness rather than just immediate ROI.

feed.title: Announcing Winners of the 2022 Workday Partner Innovation Awards
feed.summary: Workday has announced the winners of its second annual Partner Innovation Awards, recognizing services and software partners for their outstanding contributions. These awards highlight specialized solutions that help Workday customers navigate a changing world, extending key Workday solutions across various industries. The winning innovations span financial services, healthcare, retail, technology, and more, demonstrating a commitment to customer success and technological advancement within the Workday ecosystem.

feed.title: The Importance of Ink Cartridge Recycling
feed.summary: This article discusses the environmental benefits of recycling ink cartridges, highlighting HP's closed-loop recycling program, Planet Partners. It explains how recycling helps reduce plastic waste, supports communities, and ensures the use of quality OEM products. The article also provides multiple convenient methods for consumers to recycle their used HP ink cartridges.

feed.title: IonQ to Present Research at American Physical Society (APS) Annual Meeting 2022
feed.summary: IonQ announced its participation in the American Physical Society (APS) March Meeting 2022, where co-founder and CTO Jungsang Kim will be honored for his pioneering contributions to quantum computing. IonQ researchers will present new advances in quantum chemistry simulations, risk aggregation using quantum generative modeling, and general quantum learning of joint probability distribution functions. The company will also discuss application-oriented performance benchmarks for quantum computing, including its new #AQ single-number benchmark.

feed.title: Texas Roadhouse Partners With Ziosk to Roll Out a Tableside Ordering And Payment Platform
feed.summary: Texas Roadhouse has implemented Ziosk's Cloud Commerce Platform, named Roadhouse Pay, for digital tableside ordering and payments, enhancing the dining experience with features like pay-at-the-table technology and NFC transactions. The service has seen high adoption rates and improved customer satisfaction, reflecting a growing industry trend towards tableside solutions since the pandemic. The tableside ordering and payment sector is becoming increasingly competitive, with several companies vying for market share.

feed.title: Metaverse Technology Redefining Digital Experience
feed.summary: The metaverse is emerging as a significant technological advancement, moving beyond gaming to redefine digital experiences across various industries. Companies like Facebook (Meta), Nike, and Microsoft are investing heavily, with projections indicating global metaverse revenue could approach $800 billion by 2024. While offering potential for retail, enterprise solutions, and new markets like virtual real estate and entertainment, the metaverse also faces challenges related to data security, legal frameworks, skilled resources, VR device limitations, and potential negative societal impacts.

feed.title: Four ways companies can find the ‘hidden talent’
feed.summary: Many companies struggle to find talent despite a large pool of "hidden workers." This article outlines four strategies for companies to tap into this underserved talent pool. These strategies include implementing "returnships," upskilling current employees, directly collaborating with educational institutions, and removing college degree requirements from job descriptions.

feed.title: Coca-Cola FEMSA se transforma digitalmente para mantener siempre conectados a sus colaboradores
feed.summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA has partnered with Microsoft to implement digital transformation initiatives, particularly focusing on Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams, to enhance communication and collaboration among its employees across 10 countries. This strategic alliance has allowed Coca-Cola FEMSA to optimize operational processes, maintain business continuity, and facilitate remote work, as evidenced by over 200,000 interactions among 19,200 employees and the successful virtual "Semana de Desarrollo" event. The company emphasizes the importance of flexible technological allies to adapt to changing operational needs and ensure continuity in a new normal.

feed.title: CheckPoint vs Trend Micro | Full Disk Encryption Comparison
feed.summary: This article compares Check Point Full Disk Encryption Software Blade and Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption, two cybersecurity tools designed to protect data on various devices. It details their features, including encryption standards, pre-boot authentication, deployment options, and reporting capabilities, to help organizations choose the best solution for their data protection needs. Both products offer robust encryption and management features, with pricing available upon contacting the respective vendors.

feed.title: Embracing Automation Technologies: 5 Tips for Modernizing Mortgage Origination
feed.summary: The article discusses the challenges faced by the mortgage origination industry, including cyclical market conditions, market disruption from fintechs, and shifting consumer expectations. It presents five tips for modernizing mortgage origination through automation: making automation a standard practice, being innovative without being disruptive, eliminating manual document processing, making the process painless and personalized, and enhancing a buyer's bargaining power. The authors advocate for an automation-first approach to reduce costs, increase speed to close, and improve customer experience.

feed.title: Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices drops ‘medical devices’ in rebranding
feed.summary: Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices has rebranded as Johnson & Johnson MedTech to reflect its deeper involvement in digital technology. The company stated this change aligns with its focus on breakthrough scientific innovation and reimagining health in an increasingly digital world, emphasizing smarter, less invasive, and more personalized healthcare solutions. The rebranding highlights its position as a leading medtech innovator, encompassing areas like interventional solutions, orthopedics, surgery, and vision.

feed.title: Rimac Seguros Accelerates Its Digital Transformation by Migrating to Microsoft Azure with Kyndryl
feed.summary: Kyndryl and RIMAC Seguros have announced a three-year agreement for Kyndryl to lead RIMAC's digital transformation, migrating its mission-critical IT systems and business applications to Microsoft Azure. This move aims to enhance the Peruvian insurance company's agility, resiliency, security, and compliance. The initiative will improve customer experiences through faster response times and business continuity, leveraging Kyndryl's cloud expertise and its strategic partnership with Microsoft.

feed.title: Half of Perfect Dark core developers reportedly left The Initiative during 2021
feed.summary: A report indicates that around 34 core developers, including the game director and lead level designer, left The Initiative in 2021 during the development of the Perfect Dark reboot. Despite this "exodus" leaving fewer than 50 people at the studio, management remains confident, and Crystal Dynamics continues to assist with development. The mass departure is speculated to be due to slow progress and a lack of creative freedom, potentially impacting the game's development.

feed.title: SentinelOne acquires Attivo Networks for $617M
feed.summary: SentinelOne is set to acquire Attivo Networks for $616.5 million, aiming to integrate Attivo's identity threat detection and response services, particularly for Active Directory and cloud environments, into its extended detection and response (XDR) offerings. This acquisition will expand SentinelOne's capabilities in identity and access management, addressing a critical gap in threat detection and user behavior analysis, especially given the rising trend of credential-based attacks. The move follows SentinelOne's significant IPO and is expected to bolster its hypergrowth and accelerate zero-trust adoption.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs ActiveBeta World Low Vol Plus Equity ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (BATS:GLOV)
feed.summary: This article provides details on the Goldman Sachs ActiveBeta World Low Vol Plus Equity ETF (GLOV), including its stock price, key statistics, and holdings. GLOV invests in large- and mid-cap stocks in developed markets, focusing on value, momentum, quality, and low volatility factors. The ETF was launched on March 15, 2022, and is managed by Goldman Sachs.

feed.title: Webroot sues CrowdStrike, Sophos, others over alleged patent infringement
feed.summary: Webroot and its parent company OpenText are suing Trend Micro, Sophos, Kaspersky, and CrowdStrike for alleged infringement of several malware detection patents, some dating back to 2005. The lawsuits, filed in the Western District of Texas, claim these defendants infringe upon Webroot's intellectual property related to endpoint security products and platforms. Competitors and observers criticized the move, with CrowdStrike calling it typical of a "patent troll" and others viewing it as "patent bullying."

feed.title: Corporate tax departments face intertwined challenges: A talent shortage, regulatory uncertainty, and difficulty leveraging data
feed.summary: Corporate tax departments are grappling with a talent shortage, an uncertain regulatory landscape, and difficulties in leveraging data effectively. A KPMG survey highlighted talent as the biggest risk, exacerbated by the ongoing "Great Resignation" and fewer individuals entering the accounting profession. Additionally, evolving business and regulatory environments require tax professionals to develop broader skill sets and utilize technology for strategic guidance, but many departments lack the necessary tools and expertise.

feed.title: SaaS customer relationship management (CRM) Market size to grow by USD 44.17 billion | Retail end-users to exhibit maximum demand | Technavio
feed.summary: The SaaS Customer Relationship Management (CRM) market is projected to grow by USD 44.17 billion between 2020 and 2025, exhibiting a CAGR of 14%. Retail end-users are expected to drive the highest demand, significantly contributing to market growth due to the expansion of retail and e-commerce. North America is anticipated to dominate the market geographically, accounting for 52% of the global market expansion, primarily driven by the increasing adoption of cloud-based offerings and the need for customer information analysis.

feed.title: Electronic Arts stops sales in Russia, bans Russian teams from esports events
feed.summary: Electronic Arts has ceased sales of its games, content, and virtual currency in Russia and Belarus in response to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. The company has also removed Russian teams from its sports video games FIFA 22 and NHL 22, and banned teams from both Russia and Belarus from competing in official esports events. This action comes amidst a broader trend of companies, including Microsoft and CD Projekt Group, pulling out of the Russian market and following an appeal from Ukraine's deputy prime minister.

feed.title: More than half of APAC Healthcare Technology start-ups surveyed see the pandemic as an enabler for innovation while talent recruitment is reported as the biggest challenge by the majority
feed.summary: A Medtronic-Economist Impact whitepaper reveals that over half of APAC healthcare technology startups view the COVID-19 pandemic as a catalyst for innovation, despite talent recruitment being reported as the biggest challenge by 80% of surveyed startups. This finding was a key discussion point at the first Medtronic Open Innovation Conference (MAIC 2022) in Singapore, which aimed to foster collaboration within the healthcare technology ecosystem. Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) reinforced its commitment to the region by announcing plans to invest up to US$50 million through its Open Innovation Platform and the upcoming Digital Medtronic Innovation Center (dMIC) in Singapore.

feed.title: Rogers and Microsoft announce strategic alliance to revolutionize hybrid workplace communications and power 5G innovation across Canada with Azure
feed.summary: Rogers and Microsoft have announced a five-year strategic alliance to accelerate digitization for businesses in Canada, focusing on hybrid work and 5G-enabled solutions. Rogers will leverage Microsoft Azure for its cloud infrastructure and will be the first in Canada to offer Operator Connect Mobile, a comprehensive communication and collaboration solution built on Microsoft Teams. This partnership aims to enhance customer digital experiences, drive 5G innovation through Azure, and provide secure, reliable communication services, enabling businesses to reduce costs and improve agility.

feed.title: Microsoft announces new research and technology to make hybrid work work
feed.summary: Microsoft released its second annual Work Trend Index report, "Great Expectations: Making Hybrid Work Work," and announced new features across Teams, Microsoft 365, Surface Hub, and Microsoft Viva to support hybrid work. The report highlights five urgent trends, including a new "worth it" equation for employees and challenges for managers and leaders in navigating hybrid work. Microsoft is introducing product innovations like Teams Connect shared channels, a new meeting layout for Teams Rooms, AI-powered Surface Hub 2 Smart Camera, and language interpretation features to improve the hybrid work experience.

feed.title: Great Expectations: Making Hybrid Work Work
feed.summary: This article discusses the evolving landscape of hybrid work, highlighting how employee expectations have changed significantly since the pandemic, prioritizing health, well-being, and flexibility. Based on a Microsoft Work Trend Index study of 31,000 people, it outlines five key trends for leaders, emphasizing the need to empower managers, rethink the office's role, rebuild social capital in a digital-first world, and establish sustainable flexible work practices to avoid digital exhaustion. The study reveals that employees are actively reshaping their work lives, making flexibility and wellbeing non-negotiable for future success.

feed.title: ProShares Metaverse ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:VERS) $VERS
feed.summary: The ProShares Metaverse ETF (VERS) tracks the Solactive Metaverse Theme index, investing in companies poised to benefit from the Metaverse's development. Launched on March 15, 2022, the ETF holds major tech companies like Amazon, Microsoft, and NVIDIA among its top holdings. feed.title: Fortum and Microsoft announce world’s largest collaboration to heat homes, services and businesses with sustainable waste heat from new data centre region
feed.summary: Fortum and Microsoft have partnered to create the world's largest waste heat recycling concept, using excess heat from a new Microsoft data center region in Helsinki to warm homes and businesses. This initiative will reduce approximately 400,000 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and utilize 100% emission-free electricity in the data centers. The project leverages Fortum's extensive district heating infrastructure, making Finland's energy system greener and promoting sustainable digitalization.

feed.title: Zim worth over $10b
feed.summary: Zim Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. has achieved a market capitalization exceeding $10 billion, with its share price rising nearly 500% since its IPO in January 2021. This surge is attributed to the boom in global shipping and supply chain disruptions. The company reported a record net profit of $4.6 billion in 2021, the largest ever by an Israeli company, and plans to allocate stock options to its CEO, chairman, and directors.

feed.title: Microsoft announces new research and technology to make hybrid work, work
feed.summary: Microsoft has released its second annual Work Trend Index report, "Great Expectations: Making Hybrid Work Work," alongside new features for Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Surface Hub, and Microsoft Viva to enhance hybrid work. The report identifies five key trends showing that employees have new expectations for work, emphasizing health and well-being, and that managers are caught between leadership and employee demands. Microsoft aims to help organizations adapt to these shifts with new technological innovations that improve collaboration and flexibility in a hybrid environment.

feed.title: The Impact of Design on the Employee Experience
feed.summary: Workday's Chief Design Officer, Jeff Gelfuso, emphasizes the importance of delivering seamless and engaging end-to-end experiences for employees within enterprise software, mirroring consumer software expectations. He discusses how Workday is achieving this through simplification, personalization, connectedness, and data-driven insights. The article highlights key design principles and Workday's initiatives like Engage, Everywhere, and Empower to improve the employee experience.

feed.title: GM bets $3.5 billion more on self-driving tech unit as SoftBank exits
feed.summary: General Motors (GM) is increasing its investment in its self-driving car subsidiary, Cruise, by approximately $3.5 billion, as SoftBank's Vision Fund exits its stake. GM will pay $2.1 billion to acquire SoftBank's share and make another $1.35 billion investment committed by SoftBank in 2018, bringing GM's total stake to 80%. This move raises questions about Cruise's near-term revenue generation and the financial commitment required from GM and its partners to fund the unit's development.

feed.title: 3rd Gen AMD EPYC Processors with AMD 3D V-Cache Technology Deliver Outstanding Leadership Performance in Technical Computing Workloads
feed.summary: AMD has announced the general availability of its 3rd Gen EPYC processors with AMD 3D V-Cache technology, codenamed "Milan-X." These processors are the world's first data center CPUs to use 3D die stacking and are built on the "Zen 3" core architecture. They offer up to a 66% performance uplift in technical computing workloads and feature the industry's largest L3 cache for applications like CFD, FEA, and EDA.

feed.title: Regina Miracle
feed.summary: Regina Miracle International Holdings Limited chose Check Point Harmony to enhance its cybersecurity defenses. The solution dramatically improved the company's ability to prevent phishing and malware attacks on files, endpoints, and credentials, while also simplifying security management across its over 7200 devices. These measures helped them gain better visibility into threats and significantly reduce time spent on security responses.

feed.title: Billionaires Elon Musk and Michael Saylor: Dump the Dollar and Buy Physical Things
feed.summary: Elon Musk and Michael Saylor advise investors to own "physical things" or scarce assets like Bitcoin instead of cash to combat high inflation. Musk, despite selling his homes and not considering digital assets "physical," champions property and stocks in good companies. The article emphasizes that cash is losing value due to inflation, while physical assets like homes and used vehicles have seen significant price increases.

feed.title: IonQ Aria, Newest Quantum Computer, Coming to Microsoft’s Azure Quantum Platform
feed.summary: IonQ announced a partnership with Microsoft to bring its latest quantum system, IonQ Aria, to the Azure Quantum platform. IonQ Aria, featuring 20 Algorithmic Qubits (#AQ), is considered the industry's most powerful quantum computer based on standard benchmarks. This collaboration aims to democratize access to quantum computing, allowing individuals with an internet connection to utilize IonQ Aria's capabilities.

feed.title: Moon Studios’ “oppressive” culture could have affected Microsoft’s decision to not work with Ori devs again
feed.summary: Moon Studios, known for the critically acclaimed Ori series, has been accused of fostering a toxic and oppressive workplace culture by former employees. This alleged mismanagement reportedly caused mental health issues for staff and may have been the underlying reason for Microsoft's decision to end its decade-long partnership with the studio. The studio's co-founders, Gennadiy Korol and Thomas Mahler, have denied the allegations, stating their commitment to fostering a vibrant culture.

feed.title: The Best Microsoft Teams Apps for Team Tracking
feed.summary: This article reviews several Microsoft Teams apps designed for team tracking and productivity. It highlights tools like Jibble for time and attendance, Human Resources (Dynamics 365) for leave management, Timeneye for project tracking, TimeClock 365 for attendance and location, AttendanceBot for PTO and shift planning, Vacation Tracker for leave requests, and Azure Boards for project management. The article aims to help businesses effectively monitor employee productivity, attendance, and project progress within the Microsoft Teams ecosystem.

feed.title: Microsoft looks poised to dominate the quantum computing industry
feed.summary: Microsoft has recently announced a breakthrough in quantum computing with the invention of "topological qubits," which they claim will lead to scalable quantum computers. This development positions Microsoft to become a major player in the quantum industry, complementing their existing Azure quantum services and a new partnership with Pasqal for near-term 1,000-qubit processor access. While the ultimate winner in quantum computing is uncertain, Microsoft's comprehensive strategy, including both long-term qubit research and immediate cloud solutions, suggests it's a strong contender for a dominant market share.

feed.title: Baker Hughes Collaborates with C3 AI, Accenture, and Microsoft on Industrial Asset Management Solutions
feed.summary: Baker Hughes is partnering with C3 AI, Accenture, and Microsoft to develop and deploy industrial asset management (IAM) solutions for clients in the energy and industrial sectors. This collaboration aims to enhance the safety, efficiency, and emissions profile of industrial assets by leveraging digital technologies. The companies will also explore solutions to help achieve net-zero carbon emissions, combining their expertise in AI, cloud infrastructure, and strategic integration.

feed.title: Walmart Enters the Cloud Wars and Challenges Microsoft, Salesforce, Oracle, and SAP
feed.summary: Walmart is entering the highly competitive cloud computing market with SaaS-based retail and commerce solutions, challenging established players like Microsoft, Salesforce, Oracle, and SAP. This move stems from Walmart's decision to commercialize its extensive internal technology investments, transforming into both a consumer and creator of enterprise technology. The initiative, housed within Walmart Global Tech, aims to sell its "billion-dollar portfolio of cutting-edge technology" to other retailers, marking a significant shift in the industry-cloud segment.

feed.title: Bionic Announces $65M Series B Financing from Insight Partners, Cyberstarts, and Battery Ventures
feed.summary: Bionic, an Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) platform, has secured $65 million in Series B financing led by Insight Partners, with participation from existing investors Cyberstarts and Battery Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to expand its R&D efforts and scale its sales and customer success teams. This funding round follows significant growth for Bionic, which provides complete visibility and continuous monitoring of applications, services, and APIs to aid enterprise customers in managing application security risks.

feed.title: Biden Can Fix the Anti-Worker H-1B Immigration Visa Scam
feed.summary: The H-1B visa program, intended to fill US labor shortages with foreign workers possessing rare skills, has instead become a system of exploitation for both H-1B and American workers due to deficient labor safeguards. The article urges President Biden to use executive action to modernize these safeguards, enforce existing laws, and reform the program to protect workers and prevent wage theft, arguing that legislative reform is unlikely.

feed.title: HubSpot Appoints Rob Giglio Chief Customer Officer
feed.summary: HubSpot, a leading CRM platform, has appointed Rob Giglio as its new Chief Customer Officer. Giglio, who joins from DocuSign and previously spent 11 years at Adobe, will be responsible for overseeing HubSpot's flywheel organization and ensuring alignment across its marketing, sales, services, and revenue operations teams to enhance customer experience and drive strategic growth.

feed.title: NetApp Cloud Insights gets AI monitoring and ransomware detection
feed.summary: NetApp has enhanced its Cloud Insights infrastructure management software by integrating AI/machine learning capabilities. This upgrade enables automatic generation of IT infrastructure topologies, prediction of event impacts, and the detection of anomalous behavior to combat ransomware. The software also suggests solutions to administrators and can trigger data protection measures.

feed.title: Keynote Wrap-Up: Turning Data Centers into ‘AI Factories,’ NVIDIA CEO Intros Hopper Architecture, H100 GPU, New Supercomputers, Software
feed.summary: During NVIDIA GTC, CEO Jensen Huang unveiled a vision of data centers as "AI Factories," introducing the new Hopper GPU architecture and H100 GPU, along with new AI and accelerated computing software. He also announced powerful new data-center-scale systems, including Grace CPU Superchip and DGX H100 supercomputers. Huang emphasized the role of Omniverse in integrating real and virtual worlds, speeding collaboration, and serving as a proving ground for new robotics and autonomous vehicles.

feed.title: NVIDIA Announces Availability of Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit to Advance Robotics and Edge AI
feed.summary: NVIDIA has announced the availability of its Jetson AGX Orin developer kit, a powerful AI supercomputer designed for advanced robotics, autonomous machines, and edge computing. This new kit offers over eight times the processing power of its predecessor, the Jetson AGX Xavier, while maintaining a compact form factor. NVIDIA expects the Jetson AGX Orin to accelerate the development of next-generation robotics and edge AI products across various industries, supported by a broad ecosystem of partners and customers.

feed.title: StarTree brings Apache Pinot real-time database to the cloud
feed.summary: StarTree has launched its cloud service for the Apache Pinot real-time OLAP database, making it easier for organizations to deploy and manage this technology. This service, initially offered with a "bring your own cloud" (BYOC) model, allows users to run Pinot in their private cloud while StarTree handles management. Apache Pinot, originally from LinkedIn, is designed for rapid querying of large datasets for analytics and operational dashboards, and StarTree's offering aims to simplify data ingestion and observability.

feed.title: What is Okta and how its hack could affect Cloudflare, Coinbase and others
feed.summary: Identity management company Okta Inc. is investigating a digital breach, the scope of which is currently unknown. This hack could have significant implications for thousands of companies like Cloudflare and Coinbase that rely on Okta for access management. Okta, which serves over 15,000 customers and has more than 100 million registered users, is known for its Single Sign-On and Multi-factor Authentication services.

feed.title: Towards The Distant Virtual World: Vitalii Vashchuk Shares Insights
feed.summary: Vitalii Vashchuk, Director and Gaming Technologist at EPAM Systems, shared his insights on the metaverse's evolution and the underlying technologies. He describes the metaverse as a concept aimed at enhancing communication and experiences, offering greater freedom than Web2.0. Key technologies enabling the metaverse include Blockchain, NFTs, AI, and IoT.

feed.title: 10 Servers With AMD EPYC Milan-X New Server CPUs
feed.summary: AMD has launched its third-generation EPYC processors with 3-D V-Cache technology, code-named Milan-X, which is the world's first data center CPU using 3-D die stacking. This innovation allows for 768 MB of L3 cache, significantly enhancing performance for technical computing workloads like FEA, EDA, and CFD. Major server vendors such as Dell Technologies, HPE, Cisco, Lenovo, and Supermicro are rolling out new or upgraded servers supporting these processors, aiming to offer improved performance, lower total cost of ownership, and reduced power consumption.

feed.title: NetApp is increasing targets thanks to CloudOps biz
feed.summary: NetApp has raised its revenue targets due to the strong performance and growth prospects of its Cloud Operations (CloudOps) business. The company expects its public cloud annual recurring revenue (ARR) to reach $2 billion by fiscal year 2026, accelerating its $1 billion target by a year. NetApp's unique CloudOps portfolio, which helps customers manage and optimize applications in the public cloud, is seen as a key differentiator and a significant opportunity for expanding its customer base and cross-selling.

feed.title: Tackling Global Supply Chain Disruption
feed.summary: This article discusses how Microsoft has addressed global supply chain disruptions caused by the pandemic, focusing on leveraging technology for agility and resilience. It highlights digitizing factories, using AI/machine learning for data and logistics, and integrating sustainability. The article also introduces Microsoft's Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Insights as a solution for organizations seeking to build resilient supply chains.

feed.title: First Trust Launches First Trust Nasdaq Lux Digital Health Solutions ETF
feed.summary: First Trust announced the launch of its new First Trust Nasdaq Lux Digital Health Solutions ETF (Nasdaq: EKG), designed to track the Nasdaq Lux Health Tech Index. This ETF aims to provide investors with exposure to companies at the intersection of healthcare and technology, focusing on innovations in digital health. The index was created in partnership with Lux Capital to identify publicly-listed companies leading technological integration across various segments of the healthcare industry.

feed.title: How To Multiply The QQQ’s Dividend Yield By 15
feed.summary: This article criticizes the low dividend yield of Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) and suggests an alternative, Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund (QQQX), for significantly higher dividend income. The author explains how QQQX uses covered call options to generate a 7.3% dividend, contrasting it with QQQ's 0.5% yield and the less effective Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call ETF (QYLD). It highlights QQQX's strategy of cherry-picking profitable tech stocks and its advantage as a closed-end fund often trading at a discount.

feed.title: C3.ai Digital Transformation Institute Announces Research Awards for AI to Transform Cybersecurity and Secure Critical Infrastructure
feed.summary: The C3.ai Digital Transformation Institute (C3.ai DTI) has announced $6.5 million in research awards to advance the use of AI in cybersecurity and to secure critical infrastructure. Twenty-four projects across various universities, including UC Berkeley, UI Urbana-Champaign, and Carnegie Mellon, received funding ranging from $100,000 to $700,000. These projects focus on AI resilience, anomaly detection, advanced persistent threats, securing critical cyber-physical infrastructure, forensics, securing emerging financial infrastructure, vulnerability identification, and insider threats.

feed.title: CIBC tackles developer shortage with hackathons, skill training
feed.summary: CIBC is addressing the tech worker shortage by upskilling its current developers in high-demand areas like blockchain and Microsoft Azure, rather than solely recruiting external talent. The bank offers growth opportunities through training programs and hackathons, aiming to retain existing employees and attract new ones. This strategy comes as Canadian banks face intense competition for tech talent, leading to rising salaries and turnover rates in the industry.

feed.title: New Fleet of IMAX 65mm Film Cameras Under Development
feed.summary: IMAX is developing four new 15 perf/65mm film cameras in partnership with Kodak, Panavision, and FotoKem, with the first model expected in 2023. Directors Jordan Peele and Christopher Nolan are also providing creative feedback on these next-generation cameras, which aim to improve operability and reduce noise while maintaining the immersive IMAX experience. The initiative seeks to expand the capabilities of large-format 65mm film for filmmakers.

feed.title: Netflix buys another video game studio as it builds out its gaming business. (Published 2022)
feed.summary: Netflix announced it acquired Boss Fight Entertainment, a mobile game developer, marking its third studio purchase as it expands into the video game market. This move is part of Netflix's strategy to differentiate itself by leveraging popular shows for game development and eventually creating original games, aiming for a careful expansion after seeing other tech companies struggle in the gaming industry.

feed.title: 16-year-old living with his mom is Lapsus$ mastermind behind Microsoft hack, cyber detectives say
feed.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have traced a string of hacks against major technology companies like Microsoft, Nvidia, and Okta to a 16-year-old living with his mother near Oxford, England. This teenager, known online as "White" and "breachbase," is believed to be the mastermind behind the Lapsus$ hacking group, which has engaged in social engineering and extortion campaigns, often taunting victims and recruiting insiders. The group, which Microsoft tracks as "DEV-0537," is known for its poor operational security, allowing researchers to gain insights into its members who also include a suspected teenager in Brazil.

feed.title: The High Costs and Low Returns of AML Compliance for Banks: Is There a Better Way?
feed.summary: Financial institutions worldwide are struggling with high Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance costs and outdated transaction monitoring systems, leading to inefficiencies and an inability to keep pace with evolving financial crime typologies. The article suggests a strategic shift towards digital enhancement, particularly leveraging AI/ML, to optimize compliance algorithms, improve data accessibility, navigate regulatory complexities, and address talent gaps. It emphasizes that while RegTech offers valuable solutions, a thorough self-assessment and a structured, incremental transformation plan are crucial for achieving long-term success and cost savings.

feed.title: General Dynamics IT Secures $95M AmeriCorps Cloud, Managed Services Contract
feed.summary: General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) has been awarded a potential five-year, $95 million contract by AmeriCorps to provide enterprise IT services. Under this contract, GDIT will deliver cloud, managed services, cybersecurity, digital modernization, and operations center support, utilizing Microsoft Azure to modernize AmeriCorps' IT systems and support its national mission. The agreement aims to enhance AmeriCorps' productivity and IT operations, with a base term of nine months and several option periods.

feed.title: Wolverine Enters the Halo-sphere with Launch of Limited-Edition Boot Inspired by The Master Chief
feed.summary: Wolverine has collaborated with 343 Industries to release a limited-edition boot inspired by The Master Chief from the Halo franchise. This collaboration was sparked by fans noting the resemblance of Wolverine's Hellcat boot to Halo gear. The "Wolverine x Halo: The Master Chief" boot incorporates recognizable Halo elements and Wolverine's signature comfort and strength.

feed.title: Cisco Systems Inc. stock rises Friday, outperforms market
feed.summary: Cisco Systems Inc. (CSCO) saw its stock rise by 0.86% to $54.97 on Friday, outperforming the broader market. This marked the second consecutive day of gains for the company, though its stock remained $9.32 short of its 52-week high. Competitors Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) fell, while International Business Machines Corp. (IBM) and VMware Inc. (VMW) also saw gains.

feed.title: Nouveau Monde Graphite Provides a Quarterly Update and Releases its Annual Report – Disciplined Execution of the Company’s Business Plan
feed.summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite (NMG) has released its year-end financial results for 2021, showcasing significant progress towards completing its Phase-1 facilities and advancing its Phase-2 commercial scale-up. The company is nearing completion of its 2,000-tonnes-per-annum integrated graphite production line for anode material and is actively defining the economic model for its Phase 2 while engaging with potential customers and financial partners. NMG also highlights its commitment to ESG principles, carbon-neutral operations, and sustainability in its production of advanced graphite materials for the electric vehicle and renewable energy sectors.

feed.title: Amazon Stock Rally Erases Losses for the Year
feed.summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares rallied, becoming the first megacap tech stock to recover its losses for the year,

feed.title: AudioCodes Launches Live Express for Quick Teams Voice Deployment
feed.summary: AudioCodes has launched Live Express, a new SaaS product designed to simplify the deployment of voice capabilities for Microsoft Teams. This service, aimed primarily at Microsoft 365 partners, offers a cloud-based solution for PSTN connectivity via Direct Routing, enabling partners without deep voice expertise to offer Teams voice services. Live Express provides management tools for onboarding and controlling customer telephony, supporting a wider ecosystem for Teams voice alongside other AudioCodes offerings like Live Cloud and Live Teams.

feed.title: HP’s $3.3B Acquisition Of Poly: Six Things You Need To Know
feed.summary: HP announced its acquisition of Poly for $3.3 billion, aiming to strengthen its hybrid work solutions portfolio by integrating Poly's videoconferencing and audio capabilities. The deal, which includes Poly's debt, is seen as an opportunity for HP to leverage its extensive patent portfolio and global channels, with financial projections indicating immediate accretion to HP's revenue growth, margins, and non-GAAP EPS. While HP investors initially reacted negatively, the company emphasizes the long-term strategic value and market opportunity presented by the growth in hybrid work and under-equipped conference rooms.

feed.title: IonQ Announces Full Year 2021 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
feed.summary: IonQ announced its full year 2021 financial results, significantly exceeding its initial contract bookings forecast with $16.7 million and achieving $2.1 million in revenue. The quantum computing leader also provided a 2022 financial outlook, projecting revenue between $10.2 million and $10.7 million, alongside significant commercial and technical advancements including a major deal with Hyundai and achieving 20 algorithmic qubits with IonQ Aria.

feed.title: Why has higher education decided on Zoom?
feed.summary: This article explores why Zoom became the dominant videoconferencing platform in higher education during the pandemic, despite a crowded market. The author discusses factors such as ease of use, stability, cost, marketing, and specific features like breakout rooms, while also noting criticisms regarding privacy and accessibility. The piece concludes by suggesting that Zoom's success has created inertia, making it difficult for other platforms or even emerging technologies like VR to compete.

feed.title: What’s Changed: 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms
feed.summary: This article analyzes changes in Gartner's 2022 Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms, highlighting new market trends and vendor shifts. It details the leaders, challengers, visionaries, and niche players, noting additions and removals from the previous year's report. The report emphasizes visual self-service, augmented AI, and the divergence of traditional BI from data science and machine learning.

feed.title: Pwning Microsoft Azure Defender for IoT | Multiple Flaws Allow Remote Code Execution for All
feed.summary: SentinelLabs uncovered critical vulnerabilities in Microsoft Azure Defender for IoT, including flaws in the password recovery mechanism and several SQL injection vulnerabilities, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. These vulnerabilities, tracked with CVEs, impact both cloud and on-premise customers, leading to potential full network compromise if unpatched. Microsoft has released security updates to address these issues, urging users to update immediately.

feed.title: Trimble Execs Discuss XR for AEC, Industry 4.0
feed.summary: Trimble executives discuss their mixed reality (MR) and extended reality (XR) solutions for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, emphasizing their partnership with Microsoft for products like the XR10 and FieldLink MR. They also highlight their Trimble Technology Labs, which aim to train the future workforce in construction technology and further the digitalization of the industry. The article explains how Trimble bridges the gap between the physical and digital worlds to create what they call Industry 4.0.

feed.title: Vectra: Using AI Technology to Strengthen Cybersecurity
feed.summary: Blackstone is partnering with Vectra, a company that utilizes AI technology to combat escalating cybersecurity threats. Vectra's innovative software identifies and stops breaches by learning normal network behavior and detecting anomalies across various digital environments. This partnership aims to expand Vectra's reach within Blackstone's portfolio companies, enhancing cybersecurity for many organizations.

feed.title: Best Global Company Culture 2022
feed.summary: Comparably’s annual Best Global Company Culture list for 2022 ranks the top large companies (over 500 employees) with international operations based on anonymous employee feedback collected over the past year. The list highlights companies with strong cultures across nearly 20 categories, including compensation, leadership, and work-life balance, making it a relevant resource for job seekers worldwide. Microsoft, IBM, and Google took the top three spots, respectively, among the 50 recognized global companies.

feed.title: Keurig brews a more perfect cup of coffee with Azure IoT Central
feed.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper is leveraging Azure IoT Central to revolutionize the coffee experience with connected brewers featuring BrewID™ technology. This solution enables personalized brewing, simplifies fleet management for commercial partners, and provides valuable consumer insights. The use of Azure IoT Central significantly reduced development time and accelerated time to market for Keurig’s smart brewers.

feed.title: Microsoft Azure to take on Cloudflare, Akamai with new-look CDN service
feed.summary: Microsoft has revamped its Azure Front Door content delivery network (CDN) with a new version now generally available, aiming to compete with services like Cloudflare and Akamai. The updated service, available in Standard and Premium tiers, offers improved architecture, security features, and integrations, while the older "classic" versions will no longer receive new enhancements. Microsoft promises "zero downtime migrations" to encourage users to move to the new platform.

feed.title: Builder.ai raises $100M Series C led by Insight Partners to scale up its software automation
feed.summary: Builder.ai has successfully raised $100 million in a Series C funding round led by Insight Partners, bringing its total funding to $195 million. The company, which provides an "AI-powered low-code/no-code app development platform," saw significant growth during the pandemic by offering pre-packaged apps for small businesses. This new capital will be used to further enhance its AI and automation capabilities, including the development of a conversational AI named "Natasha."

feed.title: Best Places To Work: Seattle Metropolitan Area 2022
feed.summary: Comparably has released its list of the Best Companies in the Seattle Metropolitan Area for 2022, based on anonymous employee ratings collected over the past year. The rankings consider nearly 20 workplace culture categories, including compensation, leadership, and work-life balance. Microsoft, Smartsheet, and T-Mobile topped the list of 15 companies acknowledged for their positive work environments.

feed.title: Pala Band of Mission Indians to sell iGaming firm for $170M
feed.summary: The Pala Band of Mission Indians is selling its iGaming software company, Pala Interactive LLC, to Boyd Gaming Corp. for $170 million. The tribe intends to use the proceeds to pay down debt and invest in new revenue-generating acquisitions as part of its strategic plan to move away from owning a tech company. The sale is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 2023, with Pala Interactive's existing management team remaining in place.

feed.title: IonQ Named As One Of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies
feed.summary: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), a leader in trapped-ion quantum computing, has been recognized on TIME’s annual TIME100 Most Influential Companies list for its leadership in commercializing quantum computing. The company was included in the "New Frontiers" category, acknowledging its extraordinary impact and recent achievements, including the introduction of IonQ Aria, the world's most powerful quantum computer. This recognition follows a year of significant business momentum and technical breakthroughs for IonQ.

feed.title: Synopsys Launches Industry's First Broad-Scale Cloud SaaS Solution to Transform Chip Development Landscape
feed.summary: Synopsys has launched Synopsys Cloud, the industry's first broad-scale cloud Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution for chip development. This new model, optimized for electronic design automation (EDA) and deployed on Microsoft Azure, offers a pay-per-use approach to provide unparalleled flexibility and efficiency for complex chip designs. The collaboration with Microsoft aims to streamline access to compute and EDA resources, addressing the escalating demands of chip design and verification.

feed.title: Outbrain expands strategic partnership with Microsoft, leveraging Microsoft Azure to improve business outcomes for media owners and advertisers – Middle East & Africa News Center
feed.summary: Outbrain Inc. and Microsoft have expanded their strategic partnership, with Outbrain leveraging Microsoft Azure for its media platform. This multi-year engagement aims to accelerate innovation, global expansion, and improve connectivity for advertisers and publishers on Outbrain's platform. The partnership reinforces both companies' commitment to supporting independent journalism and enhancing business outcomes through advanced technology.

feed.title: Chemours partners with Open Systems, modernizing cybersecurity to mitigate threats
feed.summary: The Chemours Company partnered with Open Systems to modernize its cybersecurity defenses, eliminating 30 different security products by adopting the Microsoft 365 E5 security stack. This transformation offers a cohesive security environment, allowing Chemours' Security Operations team to gain a unified view of threats and ensure a more strategic and cost-effective approach to cybersecurity. The partnership has significantly enhanced Chemours' ability to protect its manufacturing processes, intellectual property, and data.

feed.title: The Unintended Consequences of Taxing Unrealized Capital Gains
feed.summary: President Biden's proposed "Billionaire Minimum Income Tax" targets households worth over $100 million and would levy a 20% tax on both realized and unrealized capital gains. This article argues that taxing unrealized gains, such as the appreciation of a home not yet sold, could have significant negative consequences, including forcing billionaires like Elon Musk to sell large portions of their company stock, potentially impacting the broader market and 401(k)s. The author contends that the proposal is driven by envy and misunderstands the tax contributions already made by high-income earners.

feed.title: Microsoft Dynamics Construction ISV Adds Civil Construction Tools
feed.summary: SIS, LLC has released a civil-highway version of its Construct 365 product suite, which extends Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance. This new offering targets heavy and civil contractors and aims to capitalize on the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act. The solution provides specialized functionality for project management, accounting, and labor cost management, integrating with existing estimating systems like HCSS HeavyBid and B2W.

feed.title: Microsoft Phone Link upgrades the name, look, and feel of Your Phone companion
feed.summary: Microsoft is rebranding its "Your Phone" companion app as "Phone Link," bringing a new interface and improved features. The update includes more prominent notifications, tabbed navigation, and a simpler setup process, particularly for Windows 11 users who will be able to connect via QR code. The app's design has also been updated to align with the visual style of Windows 11, featuring more rounded corners and simplified icons, aiming to enhance the seamless phone-to-PC experience.
